concern_summary: This concern relates to managing the composition of text inputs, including handling user interactions, formatting, emoji insertion, and ensuring the composer is available and responsive for composing messages or comments.

This concern focuses on the functionalities related to the message composer, which includes determining its visibility, managing user permissions, validating message input, and ensuring messages are correctly formatted for submission in chat environments.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing focus behavior for the composer elements, ensuring that focus states are correctly assigned, tracked, and restored as needed during user interactions.

This concern specifically addresses the functionalities related to composer interactions within report contexts, ensuring that users can efficiently compose messages or actions associated with reports.
Transaction and money request comments including management, validation, and contextual display of comments related to financial actions.
Management of comment actions related to reports, including editing, deleting, and validating user interactions.
This concern involves the calculation of item sizes for proper display within a user interface based on the current screen width.
Functions concerned with adjusting UI elements based on screen height, ensuring responsive design and layout conformity for narrow screens.
This concern focuses on rendering different forms within a structured layout while handling user interactions, especially during onboarding and chat interactions.
